title: setPauser is a privileged single-write state change but emits no event
rootCause: `setPauser(address)` modifies `pauser` (the address authorised to call pause/unpause) but emits no event. Natspec explicitly permits `pauser = address(0)` as a disable signal.
impactSummary: Off-chain monitoring (governance dashboards, alerting, incident response) cannot detect a pauser change without trace-replay.
preservedDetails: CODE-011 carries the narrative. ADERYN-006 is the raw SAST signal that detected the same line.
remediation: Add and emit `event PauserUpdated(address indexed oldPauser, address indexed newPauser);`.
consolidationRationale: CODE-011 is the canonical narrative; ADERYN-006 (state-change-without-event on line 206) is its SAST shadow. Single cluster.
